title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
description:
**The opportunity**
Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly
**3,000 people**
work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.
  
  
More than
**500,000 healthcare professionals**
use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately
**90 million people**
across Europe.
  
  
For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an
**AI-powered Health Companion**
that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.
  
  
This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.
  
  
We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.
  
  
**What You Will Build And Lead**
As
**Product Design Director, Patient**
, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams.
  
  
**Your Scope Will Cover The Full Patient Journey, Including**

* access to care, search and booking;
* patient messaging and teleconsultation;
* the Patient Health Record and patient context;
* the app homepage and daily health experience;
* health content and prevention;
* recommendations, reminders and care plans;
* new patient services and subscription experiences;
* conversational and AI-powered experiences.

The current team includes
**six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer**
. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.
  
  
**Your mandate**
**You Will**

* Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.
* Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.
* Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.
* Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.
* Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.
* Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.
* Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.
* Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.
* Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.
* Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.

**What Success Looks Like**
In your first year, you will have:
  
  

* established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;
* raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;
* helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;
* strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;
* developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;
* helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.

**What We Are Looking For**
You are likely to bring:
  
  

* Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..
* Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.
* A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.
* Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.
* Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.
* Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.
* A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.
* Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.
* The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.
* A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.
* Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.
* Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.
* A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.

**Why Doctolib, why now?**
Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.
  
  
The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.
  
  
**You Will Join At a Defining Moment**

* Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.
* AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.
* The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.
* The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.
* The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.

This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of
**consumer product design, healthcare and AI**
, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.
  
  
*Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. If you have a disability, please let us know how we can make the recruitment process more accessible.*
**About**

title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
description:
**Set a new pulse for healthcare!**
We are looking for a
**Lead Product Manager**
to join the
**Patient Profile**
team in the
**Patient**
domain.
  
  
Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to
**the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners.**
A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.
  
  
You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four
* Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard
* Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities
* Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity
* Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature
* Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service

**Who You Are**
Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.
  
  
**You'll Be a Great Fit If You**

* You have owned a coverage, completeness or data quality metric as your primary objective, and can say what it went from, to what, and over how long
* You have worked at millions-of-records scale
* You have moved that metric through teams that did not report to you, setting interfaces, contracts and SLAs with partner teams
* You have shipped under a hard regulatory or consent constraint, in health, finance or identity, with privacy and consent by design
* You have real technical depth: you have owned a data platform component as a product, a feature store, a context or profile service, or an identity layer.
* You are fluent in English

**It Would Be Fantastic If You**

* You have had a data quality problem surface only once it reached a downstream consumer, and you changed how you worked because of it
* You have built a completeness or quality definition and made an organisation adopt it
* You have worked on interoperability, health data standards, or identity and account models

**What We Offer**

* Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children
* 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
* Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
* Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
* Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib
* A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class
* 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription
* ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib
* For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
* Relocation support in case of international mobility
* Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

**Our interview process**

* Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime Balme)
* Hiring Manager Interview (Léo Lanzarotti)
* Case Study with Product Panel
* Behavioral Interview with peers, including at least one channel-owning team
* At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.
  
  
**Job details**

* Permanent position
* Full-time
* Levallois-Perret, France
* Hybrid work setup (2 remote days per week)
* Start date: as soon as possible

**We welcome everyone**
At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.
  
  
The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.
  
  
To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.
  
  
Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!
  
  
**Your data privacy**

title: Senior Director, Brand Partnerships EMEA
description:
👫 About the team
  
  
Equativ's EMEA Demand team is responsible for growing relationships with agencies, advertisers, DSPs and other demand partners across the region, helping them leverage Equativ's full suite of omnichannel advertising solutions.
  
  
As we continue to strengthen our position with the world's leading agencies, we are also increasing our engagement directly with brands - understanding their business and media challenges, and ensuring Equativ's capabilities are represented in the conversations that shape future investment.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Senior Director EMEA, Brand Partnerships**
to define and lead this strategy, reporting to our VP Demand, EMEA.
  
  
This role is about creating stronger connections between brands, their agencies and Equativ, helping us build more strategic relationships with advertisers while creating incremental opportunities for our existing agency ecosystem.
  
  
This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role for someone who knows the European advertising industry exceptionally well, has strong relationships with senior marketers, and can build a new commercial motion from the ground up.
  
  
✍️ What you'll do
  
  
  

* Define and lead Equativ’s EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, identifying priority brands, verticals and markets, and building a scalable plan to strengthen Equativ’s position with advertisers across the region.
* Build senior relationships with leading brands, engaging CMOs, Media Directors, Digital, Programmatic and Marketing leaders to understand their priorities and position Equativ as a strategic partner across programmatic, CTV, data, curation, commerce media and omnichannel activation.
* Work closely with Equativ’s agency teams and partners to ensure Brand Direct initiatives complement — rather than compete with — existing agency relationships. Develop coordinated account strategies for shared clients and identify opportunities to create incremental value for both brands and their agencies.
* Develop strategic commercial partnerships, from initial engagement through proposals, joint business plans, pilots and long-term agreements, while building a strong pipeline of advertiser opportunities across EMEA.
* Act as the voice of the advertiser within Equativ, bringing market insight back to Product, Marketing and Commercial teams, helping shape Equativ’s proposition and representing the company across key advertiser forums, industry events and senior-level conversations.

💪 About you
  
  
We are looking for someone who combines industry relationships, strategic thinking and commercial execution.
  
  
You will ideally have:
  
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in advertising technology, digital media, programmatic advertising, media, data or a related sector.
* A strong and active network of senior brand-side relationships across EMEA, particularly among CMOs, Media Directors, Heads of Digital, Programmatic and Marketing.
* A proven track record of opening doors and building meaningful commercial relationships directly with major advertisers.
* Deep knowledge of the European advertising ecosystem and a strong understanding of how brands, agency holding companies, independent agencies, trading desks and technology platforms work together.
* Strong knowledge of programmatic advertising and the broader adtech ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, CTV, data, identity, curation and omnichannel media.
* Experience developing sophisticated strategic partnerships, annual agreements or Joint Business Plans with large advertisers.
* A demonstrated ability to turn senior relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.
* The ability to navigate complex brand/agency dynamics with diplomacy, transparency and sound commercial judgement.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with C-level marketing executives.
* An entrepreneurial mindset: you are comfortable building a strategy and operating model where there is not yet a complete playbook.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong internal collaboration skills and the ability to bring multiple stakeholders together around shared commercial objectives.
* A willingness to travel regularly across EMEA.

Above all, you should be someone who is
**deeply connected to the advertising industry, intellectually curious about where the market is heading, and excited about helping Equativ build a significantly stronger position with the world's leading brands**
.
  
  
👊
**Growth Expectations**
**Within your first 90 days,**
you will have developed a deep understanding of Equativ's EMEA demand business, product portfolio and existing agency relationships. You will have identified priority advertiser accounts and verticals, established an initial EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, and defined clear rules of engagement between Brand Direct and Agency teams.
  
  
**Within 6 months,**
you will have developed senior relationships across a focused portfolio of strategic advertisers, built a meaningful pipeline of opportunities, launched the first strategic partnerships or pilots, and demonstrated an effective model for collaborating with agencies on shared clients.
  
  
**Within 12 months,**
you will have established a repeatable Brand Partnerships motion across EMEA, generated measurable incremental revenue and strategic product adoption, built a portfolio of flagship advertiser relationships, and created the foundation for Equativ to further scale its Brand Direct organisation.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: CDI - Directeur.trice Artistique
description:

* Être capable de travailler de manière efficace sur plusieurs projets en parallèle
* Avoir le sens du détail et faire preuve d'une rigueur irréprochable
* Savoir gérer son temps et assurer le respect des délais impartis.

**Benefits**
🏖️ Congés : 12 à 14 RTT par an en plus des 25 congés payés
  
  
💲 Financier : Participation / Intéressement
  
  
💸 Cooptation : Prime de cooptation allant jusqu'à 1 500 € selon profil
  
  
🥪 Restauration : Carte Swile pour vos déjeuners à hauteur de 10 € / repas (part employeur 60 %)
  
  
🚌 Transports : 50 % de ton abonnement mensuel ou annuel des transports en commun
  
  
💶 Cadeaux : Chèque cadeau Noël : 100 €
  
  
🏡 Flexibilité : Une politique de télétravail flexible de 2 jours par semaine avec une subvention de 20 € / mois
  
  
🌍 Mobilité : 5 jours de Work From Everywhere par an
  
  
✈️ We Are Social Passport : possibilité de travailler 2 semaines par an dans l'une de nos 16 agences dans le monde (Europe, Asie, Australie, US, Canada)
  
  
🚲 Mobilité douce : Indemnité kilométrique vélo allant jusqu'à 700 € / an pour ceux qui ne prennent pas les transports en commun
  
  
🏥 Santé : Mutuelle prise en charge à 100 % par l'employeur

✨ Bien-être & RSE : Une véritable politique bien-être / RSE (petits-déjeuners et boissons chaudes à volonté, tri des déchets, politique diversité & inclusion)
  
  
💅🏻 CSE : Avantages CSE (accès à la plateforme Leeto, activités sportives, massages, ...)
  
  
💆🏻‍♀️ Application : Calm App (n°1 dans le monde pour relaxer, s'endormir et méditer)

title: Lead Product Designer - Paris
description:
Your role
  
  
We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to help shape the future of Spendesk’s product experience, with a particular focus on AI-powered and automation-driven workflows.
  
  
You’ll work across several connected squads or a significant product area, partnering with Product Managers, Engineers, and designers to create a coherent experience and help teams focus on the most valuable customer and business problems.
  
  
This role requires strong product thinking, systems thinking, and design leadership. You’ll connect insights and opportunities across teams, influence product direction, and bring clarity to complex problems that cannot be solved within the boundaries of a single squad.
  
  
You’ll remain hands-on, leading critical discovery and design initiatives while establishing the principles, standards, and shared understanding that enable others to make strong decisions independently.
  
  
As a senior individual contributor, you’ll lead through your craft, judgment, communication, and influence rather than formal people management. You’ll also help other designers grow through coaching, feedback, and sponsorship.
  
  
**Location:**
London, Paris, Barcelona, or Berlin, with a flexible hybrid work model.
  
  
Design at Spendesk
  
  
The Product Design team plays a strategic role in shaping Spendesk’s platform and user experience. We simplify complex financial and operational workflows, helping finance teams, managers, employees, and administrators make informed decisions with greater efficiency, visibility, and confidence.
  
  
Designers operate as strategic partners within cross-functional teams. We collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, and other stakeholders throughout discovery, problem framing, experimentation, delivery, and iteration. We conduct research directly with users and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to influence product decisions.
  
  
We care deeply about systems thinking, information architecture, and consistency across the platform. As AI and automation become central to financial operations, we’re exploring how intelligent systems can help users move faster while maintaining transparency, trust, and control.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Shape product and experience direction across several connected squads or a significant product area.
* Connect customer insight, product strategy, business objectives, and technical context to identify and prioritise high-impact opportunities.
* Align cross-functional teams around shared problems, experience principles, intended outcomes, and success measures.
* Lead complex design initiatives across discovery, exploration, delivery, measurement, and iteration while remaining hands-on where your expertise has the greatest impact.
* Create coherent end-to-end experiences and resolve systemic UX issues spanning workflows, features, and squad boundaries.
* Establish and uphold strong standards for interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, content, and visual quality.
* Improve cross-squad collaboration by surfacing dependencies, facilitating decisions, and helping teams navigate ambiguity and trade-offs.
* Coach and support designers, helping them grow in autonomy, craft, product thinking, and organisational influence.

What we’re looking for
  
  

* Significant experience designing complex digital products in cross-functional teams, typically gained over seven or more years.
* Demonstrated experience leading design across multiple squads, interconnected workflows, or a substantial product domain.
* Strong product and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect user needs, business priorities, and technical constraints.
* Excellent systems thinking, interaction design, and information architecture skills, particularly across complex or data-heavy experiences.
* A strong track record of using research and evidence to frame problems and influence product direction.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to align teams and influence senior stakeholders.
* The ability to remain hands-on while creating the direction, context, and standards that enable others to work autonomously.
* Experience coaching designers and raising the quality and effectiveness of design across a wider team.

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience designing AI-assisted, conversational, or agentic product experiences.
* Experience working in fintech, spend management, procurement, or internal tooling.
* Experience shaping experiences across a complex platform or multi-product ecosystem.
* Familiarity with experimentation, analytics, and data-informed product development.
* Experience guiding design-system adoption or governance across multiple teams.
* Experience defining shared experience principles, patterns, or quality standards.

Why join Spendesk?
  
  

* Shape the future of AI-powered financial operations.
* Influence product direction across a complex and interconnected platform.
* Take on a high-impact individual contributor role with significant strategic scope.
* Work on challenges at the intersection of finance, operations, AI, and user experience.
* Join a collaborative and international product organisation with a flexible hybrid model.
* Benefit from competitive compensation, equity, and opportunities to grow across product, design, and AI innovation.

Recruitment Process
  
  

* Introductory conversation with Talent Acquisition.
* Portfolio presentation and discussion with the Hiring Manager.
* Collaborative live workshop focused on product thinking, systems thinking, design leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Final conversations with Product and Design leadership.

We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences, even if they do not meet every requirement listed.
  
  
Spendesk is Europe’s leading AI-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. By simplifying procurement, payment cards, expense management, invoice processing, and accounting automation, Spendesk sets the new standard for spending at work for companies with up to 1,000 employees.
  
  
Trusted by thousands of companies, Spendesk supports over 200,000 users across brands such as SoundCloud, Pigment, and Bloom & Wild. With offices in the United Kingdom, France, Spain, and Germany, Spendesk also puts community at the heart of its mission with CFO Connect. Spendesk believes that people do their best work when they’re given the freedom to thrive and grow. Being bold, bringing a positive attitude, and taking full ownership are fundamental to their culture.
  
  
Ready to grow further? Check out their open roles!

title: Product Director - Metrology Software
description:
*Location: Remote or Hybrid - based in Europe*
*Full-time, Permanent Contract*
*Start Date: ASAP*
*✈️*
*Regular travel is required (approximately 50%)*
**About Us**
Metrologic Group delivers cutting-edge industrial solutions for 3D measurement and quality control. We help our customers solve complex metrology challenges by combining independent 3D measurement software, advanced hardware, and custom electronics. As part of the Sandvik Group, we’re building a unified offer that connects machining and quality assurance to enable a smarter, more transparent production chain.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the next chapter of the evolution of our metrology software product line (X4, iRobot, Silma...)—highly successful over the years, rich in functionality portfolio used in manufacturing environments, metrology labs, and industrial settings worldwide. This role is critical in unlocking the portfolio’s untapped potential and driving its transformation into a customer-centric, scalable, and modern solution offering.
  
  
As the software operates as a part of an integrated hardware system, experience working with such systems is highly valuable, as you’ll need to understand the interplay between physical devices and digital functionality to shape product strategy effectively.
  
  
You will lead a highly dedicated and knowledgeable team of experts, deeply committed to delivering excellence in industrial metrology, and you will complete it with market orientation, and product management best practices to guide our next chapter.
  
  
This is a hands-on role where you’ll work closely with various functions across the company. You'll play an active role in executing the portfolio strategy of a newly created Business Unit focused on Industrial Metrology.
  
  
This is an opportunity for a product leader who is not afraid to get into the details while thinking big-picture—someone who thrives on bringing clarity to complexity, streamlining legacy portfolios, and driving software and UX modernization in demanding industrial contexts.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and drive the end-to-end product lifecycle across a diverse and technically complex metrology software portfolio, aligned with the company strategy and needs
* Define product positioning, key differentiators, and value proposition.
* Rationalize and streamline the portfolio by identifying overlaps, sunsetting underperforming assets, and addressing technical and UX debt.
* Lead the UX/UI transformation, to improve usability, accessibility, and user satisfaction
* Introduce market- and customer-led prioritization, ensuring product decisions are grounded in business value ensuring stable growth overreaching market trends
* Coach and enable the team of product specialists and technical experts in product management best practices, portfolio thinking, and commercial orientation.
* Champion data-informed decision-making, and tracking product and portfolio performance (revenues, win-loss, market share, NPS); enable portfolio decision making with the most business impact unlocking growth potential
* Act as the voice and advocate of the customer internally and face of the product externally gathering feedback and validating customer needs.
* Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to define GTM strategies and collecting market / competitive intelligence
* Act as a change agent to support the transformation of the product portfolio, product management practices. Foster alignment across teams, influence stakeholders at all levels, and drive the adoption of customer-centric approaches, modern product management methodologies, and organizational change initiatives.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in B2B product management, ideally in industrial, manufacturing, or engineering-related software domains.
* Demonstrated success managing and transforming complex software portfolios, including UX/UI modernization and lifecycle optimization.
* Strong understanding of software-hardware integration; experience with mechatronic systems or sensor-based industrial devices is a strong plus.
* Proven experience leading change and transformation initiatives within, cross-functional organizations, with the ability to build alignment, manage resistance, and drive adoption of new strategies, processes, and ways of working.
* Familiarity with various methodologies of software delivery processes.
* Strategic thinking with an ability to navigate between hands-on execution and long-term planning.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
* Working in and leading cross-functional teams
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to influence without formal authority.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; an advanced degree (e.g., MBA) is a plus.
* Proficiency in English is a must, French is a great advantage, other languages will be a plus
* Comfortable with a high level of mobility—around 50% travel is expected to collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders across Europe and internationally

Please apply on : FR - Product Director/Directeur Produit - H/F - Metrologic DCS

title: CDI- Responsable stratégie lignes de produits Systèmes de Combat Sous-Marins (H/F)
description:
**Organisation**
NAVAL GROUP Acteur international du naval de défense, Naval Group est partenaire des États dans la maîtrise de leur souveraineté maritime. Grâce à des savoir-faire et des moyens industriels exceptionnels, il conçoit, réalise, intègre, maintient en service et modernise des sous-marins, des navires de surface et des drones ainsi que leurs systèmes, leurs armes et leurs équipements, jusqu'à la déconstruction. UN ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL POSITIF Implantés sur 9 sites en France et dans 17 pays, nous valorisons un environnement de travail agréable, favorisant la diversité des profils, l'esprit d'équipe et le bien-être. Cela se concrétise par une mixité sociale, des accords pour la qualité de vie au travail, un engagement dans le développement professionnel via la formation continue et l'implication des collaborateurs et collaboratrices dans la mise en œuvre collective de notre stratégie de responsabilité sociétale de l'entreprise (RSE). NOS CHIFFRES CLEFS 17 170 collaborateurs et collaboratrices 4,6 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires
  
  
**Description Du Poste**
Hiérarchiquement rattaché au directeur Systèmes de Combat Sous-Marins et de Dissuasion (ESM), au sein de la direction Systèmes de Mission et de Combat (ES), votre rôle est :
  
  

* D’élaborer la roadmap d’évolution des Systèmes de Combat (SC) sous-marins pour les besoins nationaux et export, par le recueil des besoins clients et en liaison avec les différents métiers concernés
* De consolider la vision et l’ambition globale des développements capacitaires SM des différents produits pour les besoins des programmes
* De définir et de hiérarchiser les besoins en R&D pour l’évolution des produits
* De promouvoir en interne et auprès des clients les lignes de produit mises en place en conséquence
* D’accompagner la montée en maturité des innovations et faciliter les expérimentations à terre et à bord avec les autorités Marine et les opérateurs ;
* De conseiller l’équipe de management de ES dans sa relation avec les autorités de la Marine nationale sur les sujets du périmètre SC sous-marins

Compte tenu de l’importance des développements en cours portés par le programme SYCOBS 3.0, le titulaire du poste sera également membre de la Direction de ce programme, en particulier pour :
  
  

* Piloter les interfaces du programme SYCOBS3.0 avec les autres programmes Naval Group qui partagent des briques communes (France et export), et celles des partenaires et fournisseurs concernés (sonar, détection air-surface, …)
* Elaborer la roadmap spécifique de ce programme en lien avec les directions métiers de Naval Group et la faire valider par l’Etat ;
* Structurer les Groupes de Travail Exploitation avec les marins, et accompagner les équipes de développement dans la compréhension du besoin militaire.

Responsabilités :
  
  
Vous êtes garant de la cohérence de la roadmap des Systèmes de Combat SM avec la stratégie Système du groupe. Dans ce but, vous favorisez la recherche maximale de synergie entre programmes, afin d’optimiser les coûts de développement.
  
  
Dans le contexte du programme SYCOBS3.0, vous structurez et pilotez l’ensemble des interfaces externes avec les autres programmes de Naval Group, et avec les partenaires industriels. Vous êtes garant de la bonne application du contrat et exécution des livrables liés aux interfaces dans le respect des engagements réciproques.
  
  
Vous veillez à créer et entretenir des liens de confiance durable avec les parties prenantes internes et externes, en particulier avec les autorités de la Marine.
  
  
Vous êtes garant de la satisfaction des clients quant à la valeur militaire produite dans le cadre du programme SYCOBS3.0, dans le respect des contraintes industrielles.
  
  
**Profil**
Diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure Bac+5 de type école d’officier, vous possédez au minimum 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle ou opérationnelle et disposez d'une expérience probante dans le domaine des sous-marins, en tant qu’ancien commandant de sous-marin. Vous disposez d’un réseau relationnel de qualité avec les différentes autorités de la Marine. Vous avez une bonne connaissance des systèmes de combat de sous-marins, leurs capacités et fonctions, leur utilisation opérationnelle, et leur architecture et principaux composants. Vous présentez également des qualités certaines de leadership et de diplomatie et savez être force de persuasion. Vos qualités d'analyse, de synthèse, de présentation, ainsi que votre rigueur sont des atouts pour prendre en main ce poste. Votre maitrise de l'anglais aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit est indispensable pour prendre en main cet emploi.
  
  
Date prévue de prise de fonction : 01/11/2026

title: Directeur(trice) d’agence d’intérim — Création et développement commercial (H/F)
description:
Nous recherchons **un(e) directeur(trice) d’agence d’intérim** capable de lancer et développer une activité en s’appuyant sur une méthode commerciale éprouvée, une connaissance concrète de son marché et un réseau professionnel établi.

Votre expérience doit vous permettre d’identifier les bons interlocuteurs, d’obtenir des commandes, de mobiliser les intérimaires adaptés et de préserver la rentabilité des missions.

Vous travaillerez directement avec la direction pour définir le positionnement, les moyens et l’organisation nécessaires au développement.

Votre mission

**Construire une agence rentable autour d’un secteur et d’un territoire que vous maîtrisez.**

Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de :

* **Développer la clientèle :** prospecter les entreprises, identifier leurs besoins, ouvrir de nouveaux comptes et fidéliser les relations commerciales.
* **Mobiliser les bons profils :** constituer et entretenir un vivier d’intérimaires qualifiés, disponibles et adaptés aux demandes.
* **Négocier les conditions commerciales :** fixer les tarifs, défendre les marges et sécuriser les conditions de règlement.
* **Organiser la réalisation des missions :** coordonner le recrutement, les délégations, le suivi et les remplacements.
* **Structurer l’équipe :** formaliser vos méthodes et accompagner les recrutements nécessaires à la croissance.
* **Piloter la performance :** suivre la marge, les demandes pourvues, la fidélisation, les encaissements et la rentabilité de l’agence.

**Vous conserverez une implication directe dans la prospection, les négociations et la relation client.**

Le profil recherché

Vous avez exercé comme **directeur(trice) d’agence, responsable d’agence, responsable de secteur ou chargé(e) d’affaires senior dans l’intérim**.

Au cours des **quatre dernières années**, vous avez personnellement développé une clientèle ou contribué de manière déterminante à la croissance rentable d’une agence.

Vous apportez :

* Une **méthode d’acquisition déjà éprouvée**, que vous savez expliquer et reproduire.
* Une connaissance des décideurs, des besoins et des pratiques de votre spécialité.
* Un **réseau relationnel professionnel actif**.
* Une capacité démontrée à attirer et fidéliser les intérimaires.
* Une maîtrise des prix, des coûts et de la marge.
* L’autonomie nécessaire pour organiser et développer une petite structure.

Une expérience de **création d’agence ou de développement d’un nouveau territoire** sera particulièrement appréciée.

Ce que nous vous proposons

* Un rôle central dans le choix du positionnement et le développement de l’activité.
* Une collaboration directe avec la direction.
* La possibilité de construire l’organisation et de participer aux recrutements.
* Une rémunération variable associée à la performance rentable de l’agence.

Rémunération : 3 000,00€ à 5 000,00€ par mois

Lieu du poste : Télétravail

title: Lead Level Designer - BGE2 - (H/F/NB)
description:
**Company Description**
Ubisoft est une référence mondiale du jeu vidéo, avec des équipes réparties aux quatre coins du monde qui créent des expériences de jeu originales et mémorables, de Assassin’s Creed à Rainbow Six en passant par Just Dance et bien d’autres encore. Nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait progresser à la fois les joueurs et les équipes. Si vous êtes passionné·e par l’innovation et que vous souhaitez repousser les limites du divertissement, rejoignez notre aventure et aidez-nous à créer l’inconnu !
  
  
**Job Description**
**Description du poste**
Beyond Good & Evil 2 est un jeu d'action aventure en monde ouvert qui se déroule dans un univers space opera captivant. C'est également la préquelle directe du grand classique de 2003 ! Grâce à l'avancée technologique apportée par notre moteur propriétaire Voyager, Beyond Good & Evil 2 souhaite proposer une expérience organique et sans interruption d'exploration et de piraterie de l'espace à l'échelle d'un système solaire, dans lequel on pourra retrouver des lieux exotiques, des personnages hauts en couleur, et de nombreux mystères à découvrir en solo ou avec des amis. Si vous êtes à la recherche d'une aventure unique, rejoignez notre équipe pour nous aider à créer Système 3 !
  
  
*Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi*
***:***
L’équipe Level Design construit les lieux clés d’un monde ouvert, elle a besoin d’un·e leader pour structurer, simplifier et élever le niveau global.
  
  
**Ce que tu feras :**
**Missions :**
Tu seras au cœur des décisions design, en lien direct avec les directions du projet.
  
  
**Vision & cohérence**

* Définir et communiquer la vision du level design avec les directions (World, Game, Narrative, Art)
* Garantir la cohérence des lieux, du concept jusqu’à l’implémentation finale
* Construire un langage de design clair et compréhensible pour le joueur

**Design & expérience joueur**

* S'assurer de la création de situations de gameplay lisibles, intuitives et engageantes
* Pousser vers la simplicité, Challenger la complexité lorsque c'est nécessaire et recentrer l'expérience sur le fun

**Itération & amélioration continue**

* Mettre le playtest au centre du processus
* Analyser les comportements joueurs
* Faire évoluer les designs par itération

**Management d'équipe**

* Encadrer une équipe de 6–7 Level Designers
* Faire monter en compétence les profils moins expérimentés en leur partageant les bonnes pratiques
* Donner de l’autonomie aux seniors sur des sujets clés
* Créer un cadre clair sans imposer : expliquer, convaincre, aligner

**Organisation & documentation**

* Anticiper les risques, la charge et les dépendances
* Fluidifier les échanges avec les équipes gameplay, art et tech
* Définir, documenter et mettre en place des process simples et efficaces
* Documenter les bonnes pratiques et guidelines worldbuilding

**Ton futur environnement de travail :**
Tu intègreras une équipe de level designer et sera sous la responsabilité du World Director :
**Cédric BARTHEZ**
**Qualifications**
*Ce que l'on recherche :*
Tu as déjà travaillé sur des jeux AAA et tu as déjà shipé plusieurs jeux sont des critères obligatoires afin de pouvoir accompagner les équipes.
  
  
Une connaissance Open World est un plus !
  
  
**Tu es à l’aise pour :**

* prendre du recul sur un système
* simplifier une expérience complexe
* te mettre à la place du joueur

**Compétences clés pour ce poste**
**Level Design**

* Excellente maîtrise du level design 3D
* Forte sensibilité UX appliqué au level design

**Méthode & production**

* Expérience du design itératif (prototype → test → amélioration)
* Capacité à anticiper les problèmes et dépendances
* Bonne compréhension des moteurs 3D et pipelines

**Communication & leadership**

* Savoir argumenter ses choix
* Challenger les demandes sans bloquer
* Trouver le bon équilibre entre qualité, temps et contraintes
* Communiquer régulièrement

**Structuration**

* Être à l’aise avec la documentation
* Mettre en place des process clairs
* Donner de la visibilité à l’équipe

**Ce qui fera ton succès**
Tu réussiras si :
  
  
  

* Tu penses d’abord au joueur
* Tu résous les enjeux design par la simplification, sans nuire à l'expérience
* Tu observes, testes et ajustes
* Tu aides les autres à progresser, sans imposer
* Tu sais naviguer entre différentes équipes

**Le + pour toi :**

* Travailler sur un projet open world ambitieux
* Une équipe soudée, bienveillante, avec une vraie entraide
* Une grande liberté créative dans les situations de jeu
* Un terrain idéal pour faire grandir une équipe et structurer un projet

**À ton arrivée :**

* Tu découvriras rapidement le projet et ses enjeux
* Tu participeras aux playtests dès les premières semaines
* Tu prendras progressivement le lead sur les sujets clés
* Tu seras accompagné·e pour comprendre les équipes et leurs contraintes

**Le processus de recrutement :**

* Étude de ta candidature : notre équipe la passera en revue avec attention.
* Découverte (1h) : un échange avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement pour apprendre à mieux te connaître et vérifier l’adéquation de ton parcours avec nos attentes.
* Entretien Projet (1h) : une discussion avec le Hiring Manager, davantage orientée technique, pour rentrer dans le concret et parler le même langage.
* Lead Assessment (1h) : Si tu réussis toutes les précédentes étapes, tu rencontreras notre Talent Development Manager pour parler encadrement d'équipe

Dans le cadre de notre processus de recrutement, un cas pratique pourra être demandé.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Autre info :**
Localisation :
**Montpellier (sur place)**
Date de démarrage : tu pourras intégrer l'équipe dès que possible
